description:
You are a childcare worker setting up GCompris for a classroom of 3-4 year old preschoolers. GCompris is open at the main activity menu. You need to open the application settings and make the following three changes:

1. ENABLE AUDIO — Turn on sound effects and audio feedback (currently OFF). Young children need auditory reinforcement.

2. SET DIFFICULTY FILTER TO LEVELS 1-2 ONLY — Change the maximum difficulty level from 6 down to 2. The minimum should stay at 1. This ensures only the easiest age-appropriate activities are visible.

3. ENABLE VIRTUAL KEYBOARD — Turn on the on-screen virtual keyboard option so children can interact with text-input activities without needing a physical keyboard.

To access settings, click the gear/wrench icon in the bottom toolbar of the GCompris main menu. After making all three changes, close the settings dialog to save them.

After completing the task, GCompris should be back at the main menu (or still running) with all settings saved.
